apple.name: One Path: Graph Puzzles
apple.subtitle: Use each line exactly once
apple.description: Use each visible connection exactly once. You may revisit dots; crossings without a dot are not junctions. Solve eight original graph boards by tracing or tapping large dot buttons. Undo, restart, revisit earlier boards, and resume your local route and unlocked progress.
